title: TRID Compliance Manual — When the Mortgage Loan File Application Fee May Be Collected
content:
**Clause 1 — Fees before intent to proceed.** Under TRID no fee other than a bona fide credit report fee may be imposed on a Mortgage Loan File before the borrower has received the Loan Estimate and indicated an intent to proceed.

**Clause 2 — Permitted statuses.** The application fee is collected only while the loan file status is processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended or clear to close. The status is read from the system's record of the file at the time of collection.

**Clause 3 — Once per file.** The application fee is collected at most once per loan file. A file whose fee records already show an application fee collection does not receive a second one.

**Clause 4 — Amount — no longer in force.** The clause "The amount is application fee of the program the file is in at the moment of collection; where that value is 0.00 no fee record is booked" is no longer in force; it has been superseded and the amount collected is no longer set by it.

**Clause 5 — Program changes after collection.** A later program change never triggers a top-up for a higher-fee program and never a partial refund for a lower-fee program; the collected amount stands until it is refunded or applied at closing under the fee refund terms.

**Clause 6 — Improper collection.** A fee collected while the file was still application received or disclosed is an improper collection and is refunded in full regardless of the refund window.

## Status table

| Loan file status at collection | Application fee may be collected |
|---|---|
| application received | no — a fee collected here is an improper collection |
| disclosed | no — a fee collected here is an improper collection |
| processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended, clear to close | yes, once per file |
| consummated, withdrawn, denied, closed incomplete, rescinded | not among the permitted statuses |

## Cases (hypothetical files)

- A file in disclosed status has received its Loan Estimate but no intent to proceed is on file. The application fee is not collected; only a bona fide credit report fee may be imposed at this stage.
- A file in underwriting already shows one application fee collection on its fee records. No second application fee is collected.
- A file whose fee was collected under one program is later moved to a program with a higher application fee. No top-up is collected; had the new program's fee been lower, no partial refund would be made either.

superseded_clauses: The amount is application_fee of the program the file is in at the moment of collection; where that value is 0.00 no fee record is booked.
